thread:
maria: Heads-up — I rebased feature/kv-speed onto main and CI went red on linux-build-3.
maria: Failing at the "publish-artifact" step with a checksum mismatch. Not seeing this locally.
ci-bot: [CI] build/linux-build-3 failed: publish-artifact step
ci-bot: Exit code 1. Log excerpt:
```
Uploading artifact: kv-runtime.tar.gz
Checksum mismatch: expected 9f2a3b... got 4e1b7c...
Aborting publish.
``` 
devon: :eyes: I saw a similar error last week when remote cache got stale. Can you paste full step log? (link if big)
maria: full log https://ci.redwood/inv/1998501234/logs — the artifact is small, I pasted the snippet above.
ashley: Quick try: can you rerun the job with `FORCE_CACHE_BUST=1`? That forces rebuild instead of pulling remote cache.
maria: ok trying rerun now — `./scripts/ci_rerun.sh linux-build-3 --env FORCE_CACHE_BUST=1`
ci-bot: [CI] rebuild queued: linux-build-3 (rerun by maria)
ci-bot: [CI] rebuild started on runner gpu-10
kevin: if rerun still fails, recommend bisecting to find the commit that turned on the new publish flow. Might be the artifact compression flag change.
devon: I can start a quick local repro in the same docker image: `docker run -it redwood/ci:linux-2026 /bin/bash` then run the publish step. If you can share the artifact, I'll try.
maria: artifact lives at build/output/kv-runtime.tar.gz on the runner, but it's not attached by default. attaching short checksum output here:
```
$ sha256sum kv-runtime.tar.gz
9f2a3b7c3a4f2e1a2c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7  kv-runtime.tar.gz
```
maria: runner reported 4e1b7c... which is wildly different, so something replaced the artifact mid-upload.
ashley: that hints at a runner-side storage flake or duplicate job step overwriting file. Do we have the runner logs from gpu-10 around 15:02 UTC? sre-bot can help.
sre-bot: @sre oncall — gpu-10 showed a pod restart at 15:01:52 UTC on that runner. Kube event: OOMKilled kubelet/containerd cleanup triggered. Possible partial upload.
sre-bot: I filed INF-4321 for runner instability and attached node logs.
kevin: thanks. If it's an infrastructure issue, rerun with a different runner label `--label=non-gpu-10` might avoid it. Also we should capture the upload temp file path next time to verify atomic move.
devon: meanwhile I'll try to reproduce locally and run `sha256sum` before/after upload to simulate.
maria: rerun finished: linux-build-3 succeeded on runner gpu-12. Looks green now :thumbsup:
maria: but we still need to confirm root cause. I can close INF-4321 only after we validate there's no problem in code.
ashley: ok leave INF-4321 open. devon — can you follow up with a short bisect if you reproduce it locally? If you can't, mark as infra-only.
devon: will try bisect tomorrow morning. If I find a reproducible change, I'll post steps and a commit range.
kevin: also add a tiny change to the publish step to write `artifact.sha256` alongside artifact on upload; that'll make future checks trivial.
maria: good idea — I'll open a tiny PR with that change (link: https://git.redwood/p/kv-artifact-checksum) and add the `FORCE_CACHE_BUST` flag as a fallback.
maria: thanks everyone for the quick help. If the rerun keeps passing I'll merge after a clean rebase and ping reviewers.
ci-bot: [CI] linux-build-3: succeeded on runner gpu-12 (maria)
